title: Ocean Oasis
meta_description: Ocean Oasis: Cozy 2-bed, 2-bath seaside cottage with a large backyard, smart TVs, propane grill, just one block from Emerald Coast beach.
description_expanded:
"Smell the sea and feel the sky. Let your soul and spirit fly." -- Van Morrison

ABOUT THE HOME: Welcome to Ocean Oasis. This quaint seaside cottage has everything you need in a beach vacation including two bedrooms and two bathrooms, a fully equipped kitchen and laundry room, Wind down the day in the private backyard, grilling your catch of the day or sip your morning coffee on the front porch while you plan the day. Ocean Oasis is the perfect place for your next getaway by the sea.

ABOUT THE AREA: Ocean Oasis is close to everything that you could want in a beach vacation. Not only are you a block from the sugar sand beaches of the Emerald Coast, and a short drive to Lake Powell, you're also in between lots of family fun activities. From swimming with dolphins at the Aquarium or riding the Sky Wheel at Pier Park, you'll never run out of activities to do. But if you just want to relax, then there's plenty of that too.

BEACH ACCESS: 1 block south of the house!

ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps 6
• Bedroom 1 - Queen, ensuite
• Bedroom 2 -- Queen, hallway bath
• Living Room -- sleeper sofa

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Gas Grill -- Propane
• Large backyard
• Smart TVs in every bedroom
• Washer/Dryer
• Coffee Maker - Drip
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath towels, wash clothes
• Fully stocked kitchen

Enjoy an exclusive invitation with your booking to seasonal bonfires on the beach! Book your stay today!

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

- \*\*\* Pet Friendly: 1 dog; $250 NRF

Parking Details:
- This home includes 2 parking spaces.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
